ruleDefinitions.name: Veeam Backup Servers Credential Dumping Script Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of a PowerShell script that contains calls to the "Veeam.Backup" class, in order to dump stored credentials. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\[Credentials\\].*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\[Veeam\\\.Backup\\\.Common\\\.ProtectedStorage\\]\\:\\:GetLocalString.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Invoke\\-Sqlcmd.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Veeam\\ Backup\\ and\\ Replication.*"))
